author: mspotter
body: So an ongoing problem i've seen arise on the servers is spawn camping. It is a cheap way of farming kills and makes the game unfair and unplayable for the users being camped. I feel it is a problem getting more and more worse and not getting looked into. Now recently i got into a heavy debate on this problem during a game this was happening on. I was told by in game players that "Spawn camping is when one team attacks the other team so badly that the other team is unable to exit out." Now this is true. But, apparently when the players can make it 5 blocks out of spawn and then get killed its not spawn camping, but merely the other team "defending the iron" when it is is on the other side of the map. When i debate this with said mod, they said they  did'nt notice any of the players camping spawn, and was on that team playing that match while the other team kept telling him about the problem. So what i am asking, if it isnt already in state, for a rule against killing players as they come out of spawn, maybe say " Immediately killing players inside or right outside their spawn is illegal' or something along those lines.

Hello. 
I would like to respond to this, as you are referring to me. 

The situation was like this: 

During a Quintus Game, one team, my team, got over-powered and was controlling part of the other team, Cyan. As I was killing many of Cyan's players, I was with two other players that also had full or close to full diamond. After making sure that both were not going against the rules, I continued. I apologize if one of our teammates were shooting into your spawn, but since I was being attacked every second, I could not go back and check. But furthermore, when one of purple's heavily decked person would go close to your spawn, I would give a verbal warning. The person would proceed to move out, and not break any rules. Furthermore, I do not understand how we are shooting inside your spawn, because if we are not on the same level as you, we can't shoot inside. The angle doesn't match up. Only if we are the same level as you, can we, and the only people who did that were leather armored people who were very close to your spawn and could be eliminated very swiftly. Otherwise, we were only controlling your top, one iron section and part of your bridge. We were not controlling under your spawn, we did not get close to your spawn, and we might have, but I'm not sure, if we did shoot inside your spawn. As you stated that you couldn't get out, you could have created an underground tunnel that stretches outside. We would not have intercepted that, because I consider that against the rules, as spawn camping. Furthermore, you never did, and that would have been an easy, accessible and safer route to go then instead of going head-charge into one of our diamonds. 

Sorry for the long paragraph, but if you have any disagreements with what I say, please respond in your own words on what your depiction of what happened that game.                                                                                                                        Edit: Furthermore, I would like to thank the owner of this topic for not saying my name directly. replies.author: suspector
replies.body:
So basically from this we can take that there is a rule on spawn killing/camping. It is just that it is poorly enforced to the extent that numerous people didn't even realise it was a rule.
We can also take that there needs to be specific borders of where spawn killing/camping will occur and how many times it needs to be met/how long it should be prolonged and who you are going for.

Also calling people 'noobs' is disrespectful in anyway shape or form. You don't have any idea about the person so jumping to a conclusion based off 1 match is pretty stupid and ignorant.

On the point of utilitarian. Morally this isn't right, however realistically it is the best way forward. Better to satisfy the majority rather than minority. However that isn't an excuse to not actually perform your role and allow people to prevent these rules from being enforced after all that is what they are there to keep the server in place and happy for the majority (the rules themselves are utilitarian).
